_comment: Framework defaults for the THEMED verification email. Every value here is overridden per-theme by the active theme's `settings.authEmails` (admin → Appearance/Theme settings): `subject`, `brandName`, `accentColor`, `footerText`, `logoUrl` at the top level, and `verifyEmail.{greeting,title,message,buttonLabel,fallbackLabel,ignoreMessage}`. Copy lives here — never as string literals in .ts — so it is visible, editable and translatable. `{{token}}` placeholders are filled with brandName / firstName / firstNameSuffix / year.
subject: {{brandName}}: Verify your email
title: Verify your email address
message: One more step and your {{brandName}} account is active.
fallbackLabel: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
ignoreMessage: If you did not create this account, you can safely ignore this email.
